root_cause: The self-hosted runner lost network connectivity to GitHub endpoints during the TensorFlow Models tests job. The artifact download step (downloading 'openvino_tokenizers_wheel') failed with ECONNREFUSED, indicating the runner could not reach GitHub's artifact service. The same runner also failed to connect to github.com port 443 during git cleanup. This is a transient infrastructure/network issue on the self-hosted runner, unrelated to the PR changes (README.md logo bump).
reproduction_steps: N/A - network connectivity issue on self-hosted runner, not reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job - the network connectivity issue is transient
If persistent, check self-hosted runner network configuration and access to GitHub endpoints
prevention_strategies: Monitor self-hosted runner network stability. Consider adding retry logic to artifact download steps.
historical_context: Network connectivity failures (ECONNREFUSED) on self-hosted runners are a recurring transient pattern in this repository's CI.
